Faq.title: Everything you need to know about Lingoberg.
Faq.subtitle: Have another question? Reach our team anytime at contact@lingoberg.com.

q1.question: How does learning with Lingoberg work?
q1.answer: Lingoberg helps you learn German naturally through graded audio stories. As you listen to native narration, each word highlights in real time. You can tap any word for an instant translation, save it to your personal vocabulary, and practice it with smart flashcards.

q2.question: What German levels are supported?
q2.answer: Our story library covers Beginner (A1–A2), Intermediate (B1), and Advanced (B2) levels so you can start at your comfort zone and progress naturally.

q3.question: Can I listen to stories offline?
q3.answer: Yes! You can download your favorite German audio stories inside the app and listen anywhere—even on the train or airplane without an internet connection.

q4.question: How do Personal Vocabulary and Smart Flashcards work?
q4.answer: Whenever you tap an unfamiliar German word while listening to a story, you can save it with one tap. Those saved words are automatically added to your personal flashcard deck so you can review and master them at your own pace.

q5.question: Is Lingoberg ad-free?
q5.answer: Yes, Lingoberg is 100% ad-free. Your learning experience will never be interrupted by third-party advertisements.
